content.rendered:
The Sherwood School District Board of Directors will meet in an Executive Session and Regular Meeting on Wednesday, April 14, 2021. To access a livestream video of this meeting, please visit the District’s YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3

  • 6:15 pm – Executive Session (Non-Public Meeting)
  • 7:00pm – Regular Meeting (Virtual Meeting – Live Stream)

The agenda for the meeting can be found here.

To submit public comment, please use form found here. Public comment will be read during the meeting by the Board Secretary, up to three minutes per comment (as per time limit indicated on meeting agenda). Please note that identifying information is required for public comment to be read aloud during the meeting, as per Board Policy BDDH, and becomes public record once submitted.
